title: Sex without crossovers mimics clonal reproduction in Rhynchospora tenuis
title_zh: 无交叉的性别复制在Rhynchospora tenuis中模拟克隆繁殖
abstract: Abstract Meiotic recombination ensures accurate chromosome segregation and promotes genetic diversity by generating crossovers between homologous chromosomes 1 . Although essential in most sexually reproducing organisms, recombination is variably regulated and can be absent in some lineages, a condition known as achiasmy 2 . However, obligate achiasmy in both sexes of a sexual species has not been documented. Here we investigate Rhynchospora tenuis , a flowering plant with the lowest known chromosome number and inverted meiosis 3 . Combining genomics with molecular experiments, we show that R. tenuis undergoes obligate, genome-wide achiasmy in both male and female meiosis. Despite normal early meiotic axis formation, synapsis fails, crossovers are undetectable cytologically and genetically, and univalents persist at metaphase I. Haplotype-specific accumulation of transposable elements generates segregation distortion favouring the transmission of larger, repeat-rich chromosomes. Sexual reproduction is nevertheless retained: fertilization yields viable seeds only when translocation-compatible gametes meet, indicating strong post-meiotic selection against incompatible homozygous combinations. As a result, all surviving offspring are genetically identical, effectively maintaining heterozygosity by sexual reproduction with parental genotype restitution mimicking clonal reproduction. We propose that recombination loss, a low chromosome number, inverted meiosis and selection for compatible gamete combinations together enable faithful segregation and clonal-like inheritance despite sexual reproduction. These findings blur the boundary between sex and clonality, linking genome architecture, recombination loss and transmission bias.
abstract_zh: 摘要：减数分裂重组通过在同源染色体之间产生交叉来确保染色体的准确分离并促进遗传多样性1。虽然在大多数有性生殖的生物中是必需的，但重组的调控存在差异，在某些谱系中可能缺失，这种情况称为无交叉性2。然而，尚未记录到在性别两性中强制性无交叉的情况。本文研究了Rhynchospora tenuis，这是一种开花植物，已知染色体数目最低且具有倒置减数分裂3。通过基因组学与分子实验相结合，我们发现R. tenuis在雄性和雌性减数分裂中均表现出强制性、全基因组的无交叉。尽管早期减数分裂轴形成正常，但同源配对失败，交叉在细胞学和遗传学上均不可检测，且单体在第一次有丝分裂期仍然存在。转座元件的等位基因特异性积累导致分离失调，偏向于较大、重复富集染色体的传递。尽管如此，性生殖仍被保留：只有当转座兼容的配子相遇时，受精才产生可存活的种子，表明在减数分裂后对不兼容的纯合组合存在强烈选择。结果，所有存活的后代在基因组上完全相同，实际上通过性生殖保持异质性，父母基因型的恢复模拟了克隆繁殖。我们提出，重组丧失、低染色体数、倒置减数分裂以及对兼容配子组合的选择共同实现了可靠的分离和克隆式遗传，尽管仍为性生殖。这些发现模糊了性别与克隆性之间的界限，连接了基因组结构、重组丧失和传递偏差。
